title: Tour in Old Town Barcelona.
text: Carlos was excellent!! His knowledge about history was superb!! We have learned so much from him. He also has a very warm and pleasant personality. I highly recommend Carlos as a tour guide in English, Spanish, or Portuguese!! Yes, he speaks fluently all those languages!!
author: Perry_A

title: Gothic quarter walk
text: Walk with Carlos through the Gothic quarter was wonderful. Guide with a lot of relevant history to tell us and super astral. I recommend
author: tricialinhares

title: Patrick is an exceptional...
text: Patrick is an exceptional tour guide. We had just arrived in Barcelona and Patrick provided a wonderful introduction to the old city. Using his great storytelling skills, we didn’t just learn about today’s Barcelona but also about its history as well. Throughout the fun afternoon tour, Patrick was engaging, detailed, and humorous. Thank you!
author: Jonathan_L

title: Carlos was excellent. He...
text: Carlos was excellent. He took plenty of time to explain what we were seeing. He had many pictures that illustrated what the neighborhood looked like in the past.
author: Barbara_R

title: Gothic quarter tour
text:
We had a pleasant morning tour with Carlos.
This being the first time in Barcelona, it was very helpful to have a local guide like Carlos explain history and significance of Gothic quarters.  We highly recommend this tour !!
author: Inkyung_Y

title: Barcelona revealed
text: Our guide Carlos was excellent! He was extremely knowledgeable on the history of Barcelona and Spain.  Additionally he was accommodating to our walking speed due to recent slowed mobility. We highly recommend this tour.
author: Anna_M

title: Great time with Patrick
text: Patrick was a great guide for this private walking tour! We communicated beforehand about the time and he was right there waiting for us. His tour is full of interesting facts about the history of Barcelona and the Gothic Quarter specifically. We especially appreciated his recommendations for local bars, restaurants, churros, and gelato—all were excellent!
author: katiekL9637ZZ

title: An excellent morning tour
text: Patrick was knowledgeable and responsive to our questions and comments. He kept the tour moving without seeming rushed, mixed the serious  and lighter topics nicely and gave us a terrific historical and cultural introduction to this part of Barcelona.
author: ruthes2015

title: This tour worked really...
text: This tour worked really well for my family. Carlos was fun, knowledgeable, and flexible. He engaged my kids (the poop log really got their attention) as well as the adults. We loved that it was private so we could move at our own pace.
author: Ashley_S

title: A walk with Carlos
text: Carlos’s knowledge and passion shone through. He showed us so many interesting parts of the old town
author: David_M
